# ufbx

Vendored single-file FBX parser used by `DoodleMeshLoader` / `DoodleFbxImport`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx
- Version: 0.23.1 (`UFBX_HEADER_VERSION` in `ufbx.h`)
- Files: `ufbx.h`, `ufbx.c`, `LICENSE` copied verbatim from upstream.
- License: MIT or public domain, see `LICENSE`.

Do not edit the vendored files locally; update both `ufbx.h` and `ufbx.c`
together when upgrading.
